verdict.rationale: Granola ships a built-in AI assistant, Granola Chat. It answers questions across meetings, and users can delegate post-meeting tasks to it: drafting and sending follow-up emails and Slack messages, and scheduling Google Calendar events, with a review step before anything is sent. Recipes, automatic follow-up drafts and pre-meeting briefs add more delegated work. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of Chat's task delegation (the community evidence covers other features), and breadth of delegable actions beyond email, Slack and calendar.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product

citations.quote: Granola Chat can help you complete the work that comes after a meeting, without switching between your notes and other apps.
Ask Chat to: draft and send a follow-up email, draft and send a Slack message, find a time and create a Google Calendar event
Use Granola Chat to draft follow-up emails, send Slack messages, and schedule Google Calendar events — with a review step before anything is sent or created.
Granola Chat lets you ask questions about your meetings and get instant insights from your notes or transcripts.
